safeProjectionRequirements.positiveAllowlist: Only fixed, explicitly enumerated name/code classifications. Arbitrary strings remain unknown or unobserved, even if short. Existing ManagementCommandError class must keep its original meaning.
safeProjectionRequirements.originalObject: Project only the error already caught by the original run rejection. A cause code, if included, is limited to one own-data cause object and one own-data code; no recursive serialization or scanning.
safeProjectionRequirements.noAccessorExecution: Follow the existing Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor discipline and accept value descriptors only. Do not invoke getters, constructor/toString/toJSON helpers, message/stack formatting or arbitrary prototype traversal. A throwing reflection/proxy trap is an unavailable diagnostic and cannot replace the original error.
safeProjectionRequirements.nameCaveat: Built-in Error.name is often inherited. An own-data-only policy must represent an absent name as unobserved; it must not infer Error merely from its absence. A broader name classifier would need its own narrowly justified contract and is not selected.
excluded: message, stack and arbitrary cause text
URLs, query strings, paths, authorization/header values
request/response bodies, prompts, keys, raw provider text
generic JSON.stringify(error), object spreading or arbitrary property enumeration
mapping a run rejection into a claimed thrown close exception
safeProjectionRequirements.preserveUnknown: If the object is primitive, opaque, accessor-backed, malformed or already abstracted, retain unknown/unobserved rather than manufacture an error code or success.
safeProjectionRequirements.failureIsolation: The projection must be bounded and exception-safe; any failure leaves the exact original error rethrow and cleanup classification unchanged.

budgetFeasibility.exampleLimit: The arithmetic is a pure data feasibility example using fixed network-code strings. A selected schema must fit all of its longest admitted values, epoch/timestamp widths and both serializer shapes under the existing limits; no line/trace/receipt cap increase is implied.
budgetFeasibility.envelopeLimit: The historical receipt is 195,977 bytes. The envelope limit applies after JSON string escaping and header/details, so the receipt byte count alone is not a universal proof of headroom. Keep the original omission behavior and do not create a separate recovery output.
budgetFeasibility.lineLimitRisk: A newly enlarged field set can cause an entire diagnostic row to be silently dropped by existing guards. The full selected projection must therefore remain within the original record/line ceilings.
budgetFeasibility.sourceCap: Current ModelProbe is 500 physical lines (501 split entries including terminal empty entry) and passive-diagnostics 565 physical lines (566 split entries). No new file is needed; any selected exact postimages must remain within the existing 800-line cap.
